Name: Shadow to Visible Credit Transmission
Pathway: Exhaust traditional credit → Turn to shadow credit → Shadow obligations accumulate (invisible) → Cash flow constrained → Default on shadow OR traditional → Eventually visible
Mechanism: Shadow credit extends apparent runway but doesn't solve underlying problem. Delays and worsens eventual reckoning. Traditional metrics stable while shadow leverage builds.
Feedback Loops: Shadow payments reduce cash flow, increasing need for more shadow credit
Breakpoint: Shadow credit capacity exhausted; consumer must choose what to default on
Notes: CFPB data shows 63% stacking - mechanism active

Name: BNPL Stacking Cascade
Pathway: BNPL for convenience → Cash tightens; BNPL to preserve cash → Second plan (stacking) → Multiple payments due; third plan → BNPL payments consume income → Miss payment; late fees → Default or divert
Mechanism: BNPL ease of access enables rapid leverage accumulation. No credit check = no friction. Consumers can stack 5+ plans before any provider knows. Visibility gap IS the trap.
Feedback Loops: Late fees compound; more plans needed to cover shortfall
Notes: VX-PHAN-1.02 BREACHED at 63% stacking; CFPB data validates cascade is occurring

Name: Payday Debt Trap Cascade
Pathway: Emergency expense → Payday loan (high fee) → Cannot repay at term → Rollover (pay fee, extend) → Cycle repeats; fees accumulate → Fees exceed principal → Trapped → Default or divert
Mechanism: Payday loans designed for short-term but profit from rollover. Average borrower in debt 200+ days/year. Not bridge financing—chronic debt servitude.
Feedback Loops: Each rollover adds fees, making eventual repayment harder
Breakpoint: Consumer in perpetual rollover (>6 consecutive months)
Notes: Online migration (+67%) may accelerate this cascade

Name: Fintech Cockroach Cascade
Pathway: Consumer credit deteriorates (invisible) → Fintech portfolios show rising DQ → Fintechs tighten (first signal) → Weaker fintechs face funding pressure → Failure(s) (cockroach) → Funding markets tighten → Credit availability contracts → Traditional stress
Mechanism: Fintechs are early warning system. Their underwriting sees stress before traditional metrics. Their failures reveal what's coming. When you see one cockroach...
Feedback Loops: Funding tightening reduces originations, concentrating stress
Breakpoint: Multiple fintech failures; funding market stress
Trigger: First fintech failure or severe distress
Notes: CURO (2024) + Tricolor (2025) + Synapse (2024) = cockroach pattern confirmed; Tricolor caused bank contagion; Upstart tightening to super-prime

Name: PHAN-to-CARL Transmission
Pathway: Shadow credit stress (PHAN vectors) → Consumers exhaust shadow runway → Defaults in traditional metrics → Card delinquency rises → Auto stress increases → Consumer data deteriorates → CARL vectors trigger
Mechanism: PHAN sees stress first because shadow credit is the buffer. When buffer exhausted, stress transmits to visible channels. PHAN is early warning; CARL is confirmation.
Feedback Loops: Traditional default limits future shadow credit access
Breakpoint: Shadow credit stress appears in traditional metrics
Notes: 3 vectors BREACHED/CRITICAL (VX-PHAN-1.02, VX-PHAN-2.03, VX-PHAN-3.04); transmission to CARL vectors expected within 6-12 months
